reason: At src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:71, the patch adds `enable_advanced = request.user.is_superuser or organization_context.member.has_global_access` without checking if `organization_context.member` is `None` (typed `RpcOrganizationMember | None` at src/sentry/organizations/services/organization/model.py:298). Although superusers short-circuit on `request.user.is_superuser`, non-member callers with `org:write` such as `OrgAuthToken` (src/sentry/api/authentication.py:456-484), legacy `ApiKey` (src/sentry/api/authentication.py:258-286), and SentryApp/internal-integration proxy users (src/sentry/auth/access.py:1007-1027) have `request.user.is_superuser == False` and `organization_context.member is None`, causing an `AttributeError` on every GET request.
